channel.title: drama on Loud Legends
channel.description: Recent content in drama on Loud Legends

item.title: Ex-Mastodon BRENT HINDS Slams Former Bandmates In Exit Statement: 'A S**t Band With Horrible Humans'
item.description: Brent Hinds, the former guitarist and vocalist of Mastodon, didn’t exactly offer a warm farewell. In a blunt comment on Instagram, he referred to the group as a “s**t band with horrible humans.

item.title: The One Drummer PHIL COLLINS Admired But Called Out For Having A Massive Ego: 'The Size of a Hotel'
item.description: Phil Collins wasn’t just the voice that brought pop stardom to Genesis. He also helped redefine how drums were recorded in the 1980s, built a massive solo career, and even teamed up with unexpected names, like when he played with Led Zeppelin.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says DAVE MUSTAINE ‘Hated Playing Before SLAYER’ On 2010 Tour
item.description: Dave Mustaine wasn’t happy with his spot on the lineup during MEGADETH’s tours with SLAYER, according to former bandmate David Ellefson. In a recent episode of The David Ellefson Show podcast (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH), the former MEGADETH bassist spoke about the 2010 Jägermeister Music Tour.

item.title: The Backstage Incident That Made KERRY KING Call a Rock Icon a 'Complete Jerk'
item.description: Not everyone in the world of music gets along, and that includes some of its biggest stars. Even in heavy metal, a genre known for its intensity and larger-than-life personalities, there are musicians who just don’t click.

item.title: MEGADETH's DAVE MUSTAINE On the 'Puppy Incident': 'JAMES Got Punched In The Mouth. He Kicked My Dog'
item.description: There’s no elegant way to introduce a story that ends with James Hetfield catching a mouthful of knuckles. Especially when the instigating factor was a puppy. But here we are.

item.title: 'The BIGGEST CLICKBAIT of All Time' Involving Megadeth’s DAVE MUSTAINE
item.description: Dave Mustaine Sentenced to Life? No, Dave Mustaine isn’t in prison. Yes, people actually believed he was. And of course, someone on YouTube made money off it.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Talks About IRON MAIDEN Drama: 'It’s Just The Singer I Can’t Stand'
item.description: Sharon Osbourne still hasn’t let it go. Two decades after the absolute circus that was Ozzfest 2005, she’s perfectly willing to laugh about sabotaging Iron Maiden with beans, pre-recorded sound effects, and strategic sound cuts.

item.title: RINGO STARR Slams ROGER DALTREY Over Firing Of Son: 'Never Liked How That Little Man Runs The Band'
item.description: Zak Starkey didn’t bother hiding his disappointment after being pushed out of The Who, a gig he held for nearly 30 years as the band’s live drummer. It all unraveled after a messy show at the Royal Albert Hall earlier this year, which ultimately triggered the official announcement of his departure in April.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE Says FAITH NO MORE's Mike Patton Is 'An Unprofessional Jerk'
item.description: Dave Mustaine has spent over 40 years running the Megadeth machine as guitarist, vocalist, songwriter, and self-appointed keeper of thrash metal’s purity. In that time, he’s built not only an impressive discography, but a side hustle in speaking his mind with the grace of a sledgehammer.

item.title: David Ellefson: "I Miss Dave" But I’m Done With Megadeth’s Drama
item.description: David Ellefson still feels the absence of Dave Mustaine in his life, even after everything. In a recent chat with The Delz Show, Ellefson reflected: “I miss Dave too.

item.title: John Corabi on Mötley Crüe Exit: "Relieved and Bummed"
item.description: John Corabi (yes, the guy who briefly fronted Mötley Crüe) sat down for an interview and spilled—well, not tea exactly, but maybe lukewarm coffee. His time with the band?

item.title: As I Lay Dying: Tim Lambesis Accuses Ex-Wife of Physical and Mental Abuse
item.description: The ongoing implosion of As I Lay Dying feels less like a band breakup and more like a reality show nobody asked for. The last few months have been a cascade of exits, with band members dropping out faster than you can say “personal integrity.

item.title: Welcome to Rockville 2025 Books As I Lay Dying Despite Chaos
item.description: The wreckage that is 2024 As I Lay Dying looks more like a construction zone than a band these days, but apparently, that’s not stopping Tim Lambesis from slapping the name on a festival poster.

item.title: Tim Lambesis to Continue As I Lay Dying After Major Band Departures
item.description: Tim Lambesis seems hell-bent on keeping As I Lay Dying alive, despite the complete meltdown the band’s endured recently. Over the past few weeks, total chaos erupted as band members exited left and right without a word from Lambesis, until now.

item.title: Phil Sgrosso Joins Mass Departure from As I Lay Dying; See Details
item.description: Phil Sgrosso has left As I Lay Dying behind, joining the recent exodus from a band that now stands with only Tim Lambesis on board. After nearly two decades of dedication split across two stints—2003 to 2014, and again from 2018 to now—Sgrosso decided it was time to step back.

item.title: Band Exodus: As I Lay Dying Loses Three Members in One Week
item.description: The slow-motion collapse of what’s left of As I Lay Dying keeps unraveling. It began with bassist and clean vocalist Ryan Neff deciding to call it quits earlier this week.

item.title: As I Lay Dying: Tim Lambesis’ Wife Denies Abuse Claims as Band Falls Apart
item.description: The ongoing collapse of As I Lay Dying is starting to look like the band’s final encore. Over the past week, three members and their manager have jumped ship.

item.title: KEN SUSI Walks Away from AS I LAY DYING: "My Morals Hit Their Limit"
item.description: The As I Lay Dying ship seems to be taking on water—fast. First, bassist Ryan Neff jumped overboard, offering little more than a vague farewell. Then whispers started about their European tour vanishing into thin air, allegedly after their tour manager quit.

item.title: Drummer Nick Pierce Leaves As I Lay Dying Citing Health Concerns
item.description: As I Lay Dying seems to be unraveling faster than a cheap sweater at a metal merch stand. The band now consists of just Tim Lambesis and Phil Sgrosso, as drummer Nick Pierce becomes the latest member to exit stage left.

item.title: European Tour Canceled as As I Lay Dying Faces Major Member Departures
item.description: It’s a mass exodus over in the As I Lay Dying camp, with members dropping off faster than you can say “farewell tour.” The band’s entire European tour is scrapped, and not a peep has come from the remaining members—whoever’s still sticking around, that is.

item.title: Ryan Neff Exits As I Lay Dying: Another Chapter in the Band’s Soap Opera
item.description: Bassist and vocalist Ryan Neff decided his time with As I Lay Dying was short-lived, officially announcing his departure on October 18. The timing? Right before the band gears up for a sprawling European tour.

item.title: Chester Bennington's Mother Accuses Linkin Park of Betrayal
item.description: The rosy glow of Linkin Park’s reunion announcement didn’t last long, did it? The initial buzz around the band’s so-called “new era”—complete with Emily Armstrong as the replacement vocalist—has quickly turned into a storm of controversy and frustration.

item.title: Jaime Bennington, Chester Bennington's Son Calls Out Linkin Park
item.description: Linkin Park thought they were shaking things up by naming Emily Armstrong their new vocalist, but it’s more like they kicked a hornet’s nest while blindfolded. Fans aren’t just upset—they’re seething.

item.title: Cedric Bixler-Zavala Calls Out Linkin Park's New Vocalist Amid Controversy
item.description: Ok I know, if you’re tired of hearing about Linkin Park, this week’s been a real test of patience. And for those of us who’ve never cared much for the band to begin with, it’s been even worse.

item.title: Emily Armstrong Responds to Scientology and Danny Masterson Allegations
item.description: Oh yeah babe, the music industry—a place where skeletons in closets don’t just rattle, they throw full-blown mosh pits. Barely two days after Linkin Park revealed their shiny new frontwoman, Emily Armstrong (yes, from Dead Sara) found herself in the middle of a PR dumpster fire.

item.title: Linkin Park Breaks Silence on Rob Bourdon’s Departure
item.description: If you haven’t already heard, Linkin Park is back. And no, this isn’t some watered-down reunion tour cash grab. The band has recruited Dead Sara’s Emily Armstrong as their new vocalist, with Colin Brittain stepping in on drums.

item.title: AS I LAY DYING’s New Album Delayed: Tim Lambesis Explains Why
item.description: Tim Lambesis, AS I LAY DYING’s frontman, recently chatted on the Loaded Radio podcast about the band’s long-gestating new album. Apparently, the record’s been done for a while, but mixing has turned into a never-ending tug-of-war.

item.title: Jordan Mancino Steps Back: As I Lay Dying Faces Internal Challenges
item.description: The chaos surrounding As I Lay Dying just keeps piling up. After Josh Gilbert made his grand exit, the band scrambled to patch things together by roping in Ryan Neff of Miss May I to cover bass and vocals, while Ken Susi of Unearth stepped in on guitar.
